title: Senkyunolide I alleviates allergic rhinitis by inhibiting JAK1/3-STAT3/6 and JNK signalings.
authors: Liu, Ting; Wen, Tian; Shen, Xiaofei; Xie, Chunguang; Zhang, Rong; Tian, Li
one_liner_zh: 研究中药成分Senkyunolide I通过抑制JAK/STAT和JNK信号通路缓解过敏性鼻炎，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Allergic rhinitis (AR) is a common allergic disease with a high incidence rate. Senkyunolide I (SEI), a bioactive ingredient isolated from Ligusticum sinense 'Chuanxiong', exhibits known analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects, yet its anti-AR potential remains unexplored. Here, we aim to investigate the therapeutic efficacy and molecular mechanisms of SEI against AR. METHODS: In IL-4-stimulated human nasal epithelial cells (HNEpCs), the levels of allergic mediators were quantified by RT-qPCR. The anti-AR efficacy of SEI was then validated in ovalbumin (OVA)/Al(OH)(3)-induced mice. Mechanistic studies combining western blotting, CETSA, and molecular docking identified the molecular mechanisms and targets of SEI. RESULTS: In vitro, SEI effectively reduced IL-4-induced mRNA expression of CCL11, CCL26, IL-33, periostin, VCAM-1, and MUC5AC in HNEpCs. Furthermore, oral administration of SEI significantly alleviated OVA/Al(OH)(3)-induced AR in mice, which mainly manifested as: (1) reduced serum levels of IL-4, IL-13, OVA-IgE, and IgE; (2) decreased nasal lavage fluid (NALF) levels of IL-4, IL-13, and OVA-IgE; (3) down-regulated mRNA expression of CCL11, CCL26, IL-5, IL-33, periostin, and MUC5AC; and (4) inhibited infiltration of eosinophils and mast cells in the nasal mucosa. Mechanistically, SEI was able to directly interact with JAK1/3 kinases, resulting in the inactivation of JAK1/3-STAT3/6 signaling cascades in IL-4-stimulated HNEpCs and OVA/Al(OH)(3)-challenged mice. Additionally, SEI was found to inhibit IL-4-induced JNK phosphorylation in vitro and in vivo. CONCLUSION: We confirmed that SEI alleviated AR via inhibiting JAK1/3-STAT3/6 and JNK pathways, raising the possibility that SEI could function as a promising candidate for the therapy of AR or other allergic diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：过敏性鼻炎（AR）是一种发病率较高的常见过敏性疾病。藁本内酯I（Senkyunolide I, SEI）是从川芎（Ligusticum sinense 'Chuanxiong'）中分离出的生物活性成分，已知具有镇痛和抗炎作用，但其抗AR潜力尚未被探索。本研究旨在探讨SEI对AR的治疗效果及其分子机制。方法：在IL-4刺激的人鼻上皮细胞（HNEpCs）中，通过RT-qPCR定量过敏介质水平。随后，在卵清蛋白（OVA）/Al(OH)(3)诱导的小鼠中验证SEI的抗AR疗效。结合western blotting、CETSA和分子对接的机制研究确定了SEI的分子机制和靶点。结果：体外实验中，SEI有效降低了IL-4诱导的HNEpCs中CCL11、CCL26、IL-33、periostin、VCAM-1和MUC5AC的mRNA表达。此外，口服SEI显著缓解了OVA/Al(OH)(3)诱导的小鼠AR，主要表现为：（1）血清中IL-4、IL-13、OVA-IgE和IgE水平降低；（2）鼻灌洗液（NALF）中IL-4、IL-13和OVA-IgE水平降低；（3）CCL11、CCL26、IL-5、IL-33、periostin和MUC5AC的mRNA表达下调；（4）鼻黏膜中嗜酸性粒细胞和肥大细胞浸润受到抑制。机制上，SEI能够直接与JAK1/3激酶相互作用，导致IL-4刺激的HNEpCs和OVA/Al(OH)(3)攻击小鼠中JAK1/3-STAT3/6信号级联失活。此外，SEI在体外和体内均能抑制IL-4诱导的JNK磷酸化。结论：我们确认SEI通过抑制JAK1/3-STAT3/6和JNK通路缓解AR，提示SEI可能成为AR或其他过敏性疾病治疗的有前景候选药物。
